name: Agent
tagline: An AI agent you set up in plain words, powered by Claude.

commands.name: agent key
commands.summary: Enter this server's Claude API key in a private form. (admin only)
commands.description: Enter this server's Claude API key in a private form. Slash command only, so a key can never land in a channel. (admin only)

commands.name: agent removekey
commands.summary: Delete this server's stored Claude API key. (admin only)
commands.description: Delete this server's stored Claude API key. (admin only)

commands.name: agent model
commands.summary: Choose the Claude model this server's agent uses. (admin only)
commands.description: Choose the Claude model this server's agent uses, from the models its key can use. (admin only)

commands.name: agent instructions
commands.summary: Tell the agent how to behave, in plain words. (admin only)
commands.description: Tell the agent how to behave in plain words, for the whole server or one channel. Use 'none' to clear them. (admin only)
examples: .ag in "You are our friendly helper. Keep it short."

commands.name: agent mode
commands.summary: Choose when the agent replies. (admin only)
commands.description: Choose when the agent replies, for the whole server or one channel: when addressed, always, or off. (admin only)

commands.name: agent access
commands.summary: Choose who the agent responds to. (admin only)
commands.description: Choose who the agent responds to, for the whole server or one channel. (admin only)

commands.name: agent limit
commands.summary: Set this server's agent limits. (admin only)
commands.description: Set the daily token limit, per-user cooldown in seconds, reply length in tokens and messages of history, On GBot's own key, only the bot owner can. (admin only)

commands.name: agent show
commands.summary: Show this server's agent settings. (admin only)
commands.description: Show this server's agent settings and today's usage. Never shows the key. (admin only)

commands.name: agent reset
commands.summary: Make a channel follow the server's agent settings again. (admin only)
commands.description: Clear a channel's agent settings, so it follows the server again. (admin only)

commands.name: agent memory
commands.summary: List what the agent remembers, and delete from it. (admin only)
commands.description: List what the agent remembers, who saved each one and when, and delete from it. (admin only)

commands.name: agent memories
commands.summary: Choose who can ask the agent to remember things. (admin only)
commands.description: Choose who can ask the agent to remember things, server-wide. A non-admin's memories are only ever facts, never instructions. (admin only)

name: Config
tagline: Turn features on and set roles, channels and the prefix.

commands.name: config show
commands.summary: Shows the server's current GBot configuration. (admin only)
commands.description: Shows the server's current GBot configuration. (admin only)

commands.name: config toggle
commands.summary: Turn on/off all functionality for a GBot feature in this server. (admin only)
commands.description:
Turn on/off all functionality for a GBot feature in this server. (admin only)
feature_type options are: gcoin, gtrade, hype, music, storms, whodis, legacy prefix commands

commands.name: config channel
commands.summary: Set the channel for a specific GBot feature in this server. (admin only)
commands.description:
Set the channel for a specific GBot feature in this server. (admin only)
channel_type options are: admin, storms

commands.name: config role
commands.summary: Set the role for a specific GBot feature in this server. (admin only)
commands.description:
Set the role for a specific GBot feature in this server. (admin only)
role_type options are: admin, whodis

commands.name: config prefix
commands.summary: Set the prefix for all GBot commands used in this server. (admin only)
commands.description: Set the prefix for all GBot commands used in this server. (admin only)

name: GCoin
tagline: GBot's currency, carried across every server.

commands.name: gcoin wallet
commands.summary: Show your wallet, or another user's wallet in this server.
commands.description: Show your wallet, or another user's wallet in this server.

commands.name: gcoin wallets
commands.summary: Show wallets of all users in this server.
commands.description: Show wallets of all users in this server.

commands.name: gcoin send
commands.summary: Send GCoin to another user in this server.
commands.description: Send GCoin to another user in this server.

commands.name: gcoin history
commands.summary: Show your transaction history, or a user's transaction history in this server. (admin optional)
commands.description: Show your transaction history, or another user's transaction history in this server. Admin role needed to show other user's history. (admin optional)

name: GTrade
tagline: Craft image items and trade them.

commands.name: gtrade craft
commands.summary: Craft items to show off and trade.
commands.description:
Craft items to show off and trade. Names can be up to 100 characters. Surround name with double quotes if multiple words.
type options are: image

commands.name: gtrade item
commands.summary: Show off an item in your inventory.
commands.description: Show off an item in your inventory.

commands.name: gtrade items
commands.summary: List all items in your inventory, or another user's inventory in this server.
commands.description: List all items in your inventory, or another user's inventory in this server.

commands.name: gtrade market
commands.summary: Show all market items for sale and personal trade requests in the discord server.
commands.description: Show all market items for sale and personal trade requests in the discord server.

commands.name: gtrade buy
commands.summary: Buy another user's item for sale in the discord server.
commands.description: Buy another user's item for sale in the discord server. Create a request to buy from a user, complete a user's pending sell request, or buy an item for sale in the server's market.

commands.name: gtrade sell
commands.summary: Sell an item to another user in this discord server.
commands.description: Sell an item to another user in this discord server. Create a request to sell to a user, complete a user's pending buy request, or place an item for sale in the server's market.

commands.name: gtrade rename
commands.summary: Rename an item in your inventory.
commands.description: Rename an item in your inventory. Names can be up to 100 characters.

commands.name: gtrade destroy
commands.summary: Destroy an item in your inventory.
commands.description: Destroy an item in your inventory.

name: Help
tagline: See what GBot can do in your server.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: See what GBot can do in this server.
commands.description: Lists only what is available in your server, names what is turned off, and shows a feature's commands when you pick one. Bare group commands like .config show the same detail.

name: Hype
tagline: Automatic replies and reactions to messages.

commands.name: hype respond
commands.summary: Set a regex to match against messages, and a list of possible responses to reply with. (admin only)
commands.description: Set a regular expression to match against new messages in this server, and a list of possible responses to reply to it with. Surround regex and response each with double quotes if multiple words. (admin only)
examples: .hy rs "Hello there!" "General Kenobi!" "You fool! I've been trained in your Jedi arts by Count Dooku."
.hy rs "It's over Anakin, I have the high ground." "You underestimate my power!"

commands.name: hype react
commands.summary: Set a regex to match against messages, and a list of possible emojis to react with. (admin only)
commands.description: Set a regular expression to match against new messages in this server, and a list of possible emojis to react to it with. Surround regex with double quotes if multiple words. (admin only)

commands.name: hype remove
commands.summary: Remove an existing regular expression match response in this server. (admin only)
commands.description: Remove an existing regular expression match response in this server. (admin only)

name: Music
tagline: Play songs from YouTube in your voice channel.

commands.name: music play
commands.summary: Play videos/music streamed from YouTube.
commands.description: Play videos/music streamed from YouTube. Accepts a search, a video URL, a livestream, or a playlist. A full queue refuses more songs.

commands.name: music queue
commands.summary: Displays the current songs in queue.
commands.description: Displays the current songs in queue.

commands.name: music skip
commands.summary: Skips the current song being played.
commands.description: Skips the current song being played.

commands.name: music pause
commands.summary: Pauses the current song being played.
commands.description: Pauses the current song being played.

commands.name: music resume
commands.summary: Resumes the current song being played.
commands.description: Resumes the current song being played.

commands.name: music stop
commands.summary: Stops the bot from playing songs and clears the queue.
commands.description: Stops the bot from playing songs and clears the queue.

commands.name: music restart
commands.summary: Restarts the current song from the beginning.
commands.description: Restarts the current song from the beginning. Livestreams cannot be restarted.

commands.name: music remove
commands.summary: Removes a song from the queue.
commands.description: Removes a song from the queue, by its position in the queue command.

commands.name: music move
commands.summary: Moves a song to another position in the queue.
commands.description: Moves a song to another position in the queue, by the positions in the queue command.

commands.name: music shuffle
commands.summary: Shuffles the songs in the queue.
commands.description: Shuffles the songs in the queue. The song currently playing is not affected.

commands.name: music elevator
commands.summary: Toggle elevator mode to loop the queue.
commands.description: Toggle elevator mode to loop the queue. Each song returns to the end of the queue as it finishes, so a single queued song repeats and several cycle in order.

commands.name: music spotify
commands.summary: Play current spotify activity streamed from YouTube.
commands.description: Play current spotify activity streamed from YouTube. Songs are added to the queue as the user's activity changes.

commands.name: patreon
commands.summary: In the GBot Patreon server, specify your server's ID to enable GBot functionality. (patrons only)
commands.description: In the GBot Patreon server, specify a server's ID to enable GBot functionality in that server. (patrons only)

name: Storms
tagline: Random number-guessing storms that pay out GCoin.

commands.name: storms umbrella
commands.summary: Start the incoming Storm and earn 0.25 GCoin.
commands.description: Start the incoming Storm and earn 0.25 GCoin.

commands.name: storms guess
commands.summary: Make a guess with a winning reward of 1.00 GCoin.
commands.description: Make a guess with a winning reward of 1.00 GCoin. Multiplier applied for guesses made in 4 attempts or less.

commands.name: storms bet
commands.summary: Make a guess. If you win, you earn the amount of points bet. If you lose, you lose those points.
commands.description: Make a guess. If you win, you earn the amount of points bet within your wallet. If you lose, you lose those points. Multiplier applied for guesses made in 4 attempts or less.

name: Who Dis
tagline: Chat anonymously with a random member and guess who it is.

commands.name: whodis start
commands.summary: Start or end a mini-game where you try to guess a random user in the server you are paired with.
commands.description: Start or end a mini-game where you try to guess a random user in the server you are paired with. You have 1 guess, and if you guess correctly you earn GCoin. You can play once every hour.

commands.name: whodis guess
commands.summary: Guess the name of the user you are paired with for a chance to win GCoin.
commands.description: Guess the name of the user you are paired with for a chance to win GCoin.

commands.name: whodis leave
commands.summary: Remove the server's 'Who Dis?' role opting you out of any future games.
commands.description: Remove the server's 'Who Dis?' role opting you out of any future games.

commands.name: whodis report
commands.summary: Report a user to server admins for bad behavior.
commands.description: Report a user to server admins for bad behavior. The reported user's last 5 messages will be captured from the channel sent in, or an ongoing Who Dis game.
